scope.renderedSampling: First full three-exchange branch-zero dialogue for each template; not a claim of reading all 12960 records.

manualFindings.reason: The initial draft could say N envelopes and one envelope when the object slot was sobre, while answering N. The reviewed version uses N notes, and no object slot is nota.
The initial draft called every fictional recipient mi amigo, including feminine names. The reviewed greeting request names its recipient without that gendered noun.
Corrections explicitly replace the earlier value; subsequent answers retain the replacement. Selectors answer about the requested entity, and the two assignments are swapped within the same family.

Unknown destinations, dates and quantities remain unknown until supplied. A known current city does not establish a package destination. No external action, owner's biography or off-chat memory is asserted.
Model identity examples distinguish Unidad from the fictional user and recipient. Identity is authored training text, not an inference-time response override.
Listening and intent-change examples follow the current user request rather than continuing an abandoned plan. Feeling/reason combinations are selected from reviewed plausible pairs.

remainingLimitations: This is procedural fiction with 44 repeated template patterns. More records do not make the conversations independent samples or prove general conversation.

Vocabulary is shared across folds while authored associations are reserved. Templates are deliberately shared across folds to measure basic composition; unseen-skill generalization requires separate evaluation.
The short name/city framing and slot combinations introduce regularities. In some scenes the current city and later destination coincide; an independent evaluation should vary these roles.
Training history contains authored assistant replies. Assessment must also feed back the model's actual replies during multi-turn generation.
Collision checks against previous corpora and the development suite belong to the separate merge audit. This authoring step did not read them or change their folds.
The previous untrained draft is not the reviewed corpus and must not be merged as an additional dataset.
No model was evaluated by this review, and no conversational competence is claimed.
